Una pena que un lugar tan lindo, esté tan descuidado!!!!...Baño damas: abandono total, no agua, no papel, no jabón!!...Combustibles:  nunca funciona aplicación. Sin descuento YPF/ACA!! We go every year (it used to be a pleasure...) and it gets worse every year. The only redeeming quality is the service: excellent! A real pity!

It's preferable to keep going in at the General Roca station.
